source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology.flowers: About 20 stamens with pink to purple anthers

source_scope_note: Genus/key traits explicitly identified; modern secondary evidence separately cited; no unsupported species characters inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Named Crataegus texana treatment not located in 1999 flora; genus account warns strong hybridization, polyploidy, apomixis and leaf variability
FNA treats C. texana as provisional complex with pink to purple anthers, 20 stamens and red fruits; no direct 1999 attribution
POWO accepts C. texana and lists C. mollis var. texana in nomenclatural synonymy, requiring concept care
preservation: Additive file; existing species records, photographs, credits and galleries unchanged
